verdict: Leads are coming in, but cost per lead is rising and needs correction.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 130 leads at a cost of $6.91 per lead — all through Meta, which is working, but showing signs of strain. In the most recent 7 days, cost per lead spiked 43% while lead volume dipped 8%, a signal that the current campaign setup is losing efficiency as spend increases. Nearly all of your ad budget — 89% — is concentrated in a single campaign, which leaves no room to redirect spend when that campaign softens. We are rebalancing the campaign structure this week to reduce that concentration and stabilize cost per lead. We are also working through several planned buildouts — including search campaigns, landing pages, and CRM setup — that will add more channels and intake capacity in the coming weeks.

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead is rising week over week, driven by a single campaign carrying nearly all of the budget with declining efficiency.
watch_item.fix: Campaign budget is being redistributed across multiple campaigns this week to restore efficiency and reduce single-point risk.
